what: From the Lead via coord-1030: two blaze serve processes over one profile history (pids 52479 and 89279) both wrote build id 48. History::open numbers builds from the files already there, so two writers pick the same next id. Fix: keep_history claims the history first, with an exclusive lock on <history>/owner.lock holding the daemon pid. The lock is held on the blaze-history thread until its last flush is written. A second claimant fails blaze serve with Claim::Owned naming the history directory and the holder pid. Test: serve::observe::tests::a_history_has_one_writer_and_a_second_claimant_is_told_who.

history.note: observe.rs claim() and the test; rust-analyzer clean; unbuilt.
